target_name: Unbooked Knowledge Share Validated by Buybacks
rationale: The composition ratio TS_SUM(xrd,5)/(intan+TS_SUM(xrd,5)) discards the *magnitude* of unbooked knowledge capital that the hypothesis rests on — a firm with trivial R&D and zero recorded intangibles scores at the maximum, and firms with neither leave a 0/0 denominator — so the test cannot cleanly separate "invisibility" from "no intangibles at all."

Replacing the outlier-prone repurchase level with a count of years of material net equity retirement is an outlier-immune, economically motivated restatement of the archive's strongest leg that directly targets the diagnosed instability (high Sharpe, modest t-alpha), and the count=0 case maps sensibly to the bottom of the composite.

target_name: Capital Raised Without an Innovation Program
rationale: Because COALESCE sets missing xrd/xad to zero, the gating leg maxes out for every firm that simply does not report intangible spending, so the signal largely degenerates into the well-documented net-external-financing/composite-issuance anomaly measured on the non-R&D-reporting subsample — a data-availability interaction rather than the claimed economic condition.

The denominator (gross profit + R&D) is frequently near zero or negative precisely among the loss-making research-intensive firms the hypothesis targets, so the unwinsorized ratio explodes and sign-flips, ranking the most refinancing-stressed firms as the least stressed and inverting the intended direction.

Swapping RANK for IND_RANK on both legs of the archive's existing best signal is a standard industry-neutralization robustness check rather than a new economic hypothesis, and as such is too cosmetic a variant to count as a distinct cross-theme signal.

The diagnosis of the archived version's failure (fragile `intan` denominator, restrictive 5-year TREND, 0.073 coverage) is credible and the substitution of cumulative R&D and gross profit is substantive, but collapsing a five-year trend into a one-year DELTA of a ratio that can straddle zero trades coverage for considerable noise and possible sign ambiguity.
